text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around lunchtime, I visited an 
all-you-can-eat buffet at a family 
restaurant. Then...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Inari, hold on, hold on! What in the world 
are ya tryin' to eat first?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What else? Obviously I'm startin' off with 
my beloved inarizushi!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Soaked in tasty broth, fluffy and juicy. 
Now that's a real Edo specialty right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, it's great that ya love it, 
but this is an all-you-can-eat, ya know?! 
If ya don't start with the expensive 
stuff, what're ya even doin'?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here's the winnin' strategy: Beef, pork, 
chicken! Beef, pork, chicken! Curry and 
rice can wait! Come on, say it with me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Beef, pork, chicken! Beef, pork, chicken! 
Curry rice can take a hike, get outta 
here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Feels like ya changed it a bit, but 
whatever. So first off, the beef...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold your horses, Tama. You've got a 
seriously twisted way of livin', ya know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Try livin' a little more true to yourself! 
Eatin' what you love without carin' about 
the price— now THAT'S the Edo way!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're thinkin' way too small, Tama! 
You're tiny, inside and out! Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I don't wanna hear that from someone 
who's always fightin' me over who's 
shorter!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
B-But... is that really okay? Just 
ignorin' everythin' and startin' with 
whatever you like?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
More than okay! Toss those petty little 
rules right outta the window!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If a small fry gets bogged down by small 
things, how're you ever gonna beat the big 
dogs?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can't beat the big dogs...? Is that... 
really true...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that kinda makes sense. Have I 
been tying myself down without even 
realizin' it? If that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Inari, well said! All right, I'm gonna 
show this buffet the real, true me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, brought back a whole mountain of 
it! THIS is what I really wanted to eat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Check it out! Jelly, cake, pudding, and 
fruit! A 4-tier sweet dessert stack!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat?! I'm glad you let loose and 
all, but... why is it completely full of 
sweets?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I couldn't help it~! When I was a 
kid, we had no money, so I never got to 
eat stuff like this~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... but y'know, it feels great not 
countin' pennies for once. From now on, 
I'm gonna do whatever the heck I want!
